desc: Reliable, easy to handle, and built to last, the Duster feels like your first car: simple, dependable, and always ready to roll. Compact and comfortable, this EDC delivers utility you'll keep reaching for. The modified sheepsfoot blade enhances control for daily cutting tasks, while the stonewashed 8Cr13MoV steel holds its edge and hides wear. Durable glass-filled nylon handles provide grip without weight, paired with an aluminum backspacer for contrast. Riding on KVT ball bearings, the blade opens smoothly and locks with the secure DuraLock mechanism. Straightforward and functional, the Duster is your next everyday driver.
